name: GOV oz-accessmanager: RoleGranted (AccessManager)
description: OpenZeppelin AccessManager (v5): RoleGranted(uint64,address,uint32,uint48,bool) emitted by a contract tagged mf-privileged. Default severity high. The privChangeGuard Web3 Action decodes the change, classifies the new holder (EOA, EIP-7702, Safe, timelock) and checks for prior notice.
